audit_result.proof_trace: Discord role is created at L39 before the DB insert at L50-55; on DB insert failure (L57), the code only logs and returns HTTP 500 with no compensating deletion of the Discord role. No `deleteRole` function exists anywhere in discord.ts or the codebase, and no rollback/compensation mechanism is present on the failure path.
audit_result.attack_scenario: A transient DB failure (network error, connection timeout, constraint race) after the Discord role is created leaves an orphaned role in Discord with no DB record. On retry, the dedup check at L21-33 finds no DB record and proceeds to create another Discord role with the same name, allowing repeated failures to accumulate orphaned Discord roles and permanently desync Discord from the DB state.
